note.surprise_finding: qa5/8k mem_space partial 85% > Beacon-Qwen2-7B 63%. Why: chunked path generates verbose 'According to the text, X gave Y to Z' answers that contain target entity name as substring. qa5 targets are person/item names (single words) so substring match liberal. qa1 targets are location words (also liberal). qa2 needs multi-fact reasoning so verbose answers often miss correct target.
note.implication: previous qa1/8k=39% 'failure' is partly substring-match strictness on chunked verbose output, not real semantic failure. Need lenient match (any candidate location word) for fair comparison.

note.story_update: qa5/32k mem_space 30%p vs vanilla 0%p → +30% win extension to 32k. qa2 vanilla 0-4k filled in: 44/41/47/44%. Vanilla < Beacon by 13-23% on qa2 short context (8B-Inst weaker than Qwen2-7B-Inst on multi-fact). Our mem_space ≈ vanilla on qa2 0-4k (small loss)

note.discovery: qa5/8k mem_space=86 > vanilla=72p → +14 win on QA5 8k against own vanilla, not just vs Beacon

note.key_insight: strict substring match was over-counting qa5 because 'Fred', 'apple', 'milk', 'kitchen' etc are short tokens that frequently appear in verbose chunked-path output regardless of correct answer. Lenient (first-candidate-in-output) is more honest. qa5 strict 86/67/44 → lenient 31/22/21. Win still holds but more realistic.

note.detail: ★H1 vs H2 裁决: 主因 H1(训练配置使检索/选择子问题vacuous),非H2. 直接探针(final ckpt, needle恒在chunk0, n_ctx=7, eval lifecycle): gist权重严格均匀=0.143=1/7(std0.0006), needle precision@top1=22.5%(随机), qproj/kproj norm=14.5=init norm原值(几乎没学), 跨chunk pre-softmax score spread=0.01→softmax均匀. ★根因: 训练topk_chunks=8>=n_ctx=7→keep_all恒True→top-k选择全程no-op; 均匀权重的log-bias跨列为常数→在native softmax里抵消→scorer零梯度压力去区分chunk; reader靠直接attend全部7个chunk的raw-KV brute-force解T2→loss→0但scorer永不需学选择. 次因: gist_src(512tok均值池化)跨chunk cosine=0.90, needle 25tok被487 bg tok稀释→即便完美proj信号也弱. ★H1-as-stated(needle在target局部窗口可见)=FALSE(needle在3584 tok外,确实出窗); H1-spirit(任务没强迫检索)=TRUE(via topk>=n_ctx keep-all); H2(梯度本质训不出scorer)=未证(从未制造选择压力). 方向: 重训强迫选择(topk<<n_ctx + distractors num_keys>1 + 多窗口n_ctx>>8 + 更强gist如landmark token/max-pool).

(2) ★reader自身native q·k attention over raw-KV 已经能定位needle chunk(55%/27.5% >> 随机6.2%),远胜任何训练出的gist(≤10%). gist scorer不仅没用,还在破坏reader本有的定位能力. 架构启示: 彻底去掉trained gist scorer,让reader native attention over raw-KV自己选(=Landmark哲学,数据印证). 嫁接设计: raw-KV无损内容 + 解冻reader + 让reader q·k直接attend raw-KV(无trained选择头/无col_bias),selection不进LM loss.

note.note: ★★机制probe金子结论(methodA-eval,改变嫁接设计): gist选择与needle位置无关(≤10%)也与reader注意力无关(Pearson≈0)——scorer学了个和两者都不相关的乱规则(添乱). ★但意外发现: reader解冻后其native q·k attention over无损raw-KV已能定位needle chunk h1fix=55%(8.8×随机)/lr30=27.5%(4.4×),远胜任何trained gist(≤10%). →比H2更强更可操作的结论: 不只是'选择不能进loss',而是『reader解冻后它自己的注意力over raw-KV就是最好检索器,根本不需要额外选择头,加trained gist反而是负担(学歪+稀释)』. 整条线收束: 我们一直纠结'怎么训好选择器'(mem_space selector/Method A gist都失败),答案是『不要选择器』——raw-KV无损+解冻reader让reader用本就擅长的注意力直接attend. 之前所有失败=在reader和信息间硬塞学不好的有损中间层(压缩slot/trained scorer). ★嫁接方案草案: 保留raw-KV无损+解冻L16-31,删trainable gist(query/key_proj/col_bias全去),选择由reader native q·k涌现(inattn_kv去col_bias),可能连Landmark的landmark-token emergent选择都不需要(reader attn更简单). 待定注入层数(等S5). ★便宜go/no-go进行中: col_bias=0纯reader-attn跑W0长档,测55% retrieval precision能否转化成end-to-end答题(W0破墙). 用户关键 reframing: 既然 FIFO buffer 本来就存了最后几个 chunk 的 hidden(b25 在32k留最后25 chunk,W6窗口的最后7个全在buffer里),理论上 W0 就该=W6,不该有 SWA gap。gap存在=我们的hidden表示有损,不是SWA占开卷便宜。这比项目旧框架('SWA=开卷,gap是天花板不算成败')更准。证据: gap在干净run更大(HARDOBJ W0 12-15 vs swa6 50-60 gap~40; self-study swa0 16/11/7 vs swa2 -/26/18). 泄漏b25 gap反而小(~10-26)因泄漏人为抬高W0。剥掉泄漏真相: 纯memory hidden长档抓不到信息(8-15), 原始token能(50-60)=表示彻底失败。头号嫌疑=位置坍缩(layer.py:1244 buffer所有hidden压RoPE pos-0=无序无位置一袋向量, W6原始token有正常相对位置)。次因: hidden没见过query时算的(staleness)。★测试lever: position-fix FIFO(给buffer连续位置非pos-0),若W0→W6则读出鸿沟主要是位置bug非范式问题→直接破墙。便宜probe=eval-time给现有b25 ckpt buffer连续位置(OOD敏感度探针); 正式=position-fixed重训。这与Plan C设计角度2(position-fix)独立收敛。研究目标重定义: 关闭W0/W6 gap = 让FIFO hidden忠实 = 真目标。
